newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil sits uneasily at higher levels.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil sits uneasily at higher levels.

text.p: Fuel oil prices nervously edged higher on Wednesday, but trade was thin after recent gains.
High sulphur barges, which have breached five-year highs, were limited to two deals at $123 fob ARA.
"These are new levels which a lot of people are not comfortable with. The market is feeling its way," said a barge trader.
The same was true of cargoes. Buyers were quiet, unwilling to give an support to an already tight and bullish market.
"I think we are in the low $120s cif NWE, but I haven't seen anything done," said one trader.
Some end-users conceeded the sector was strong but said it had been overplayed.

Talk again centered on Romania looking for $160 million worth of high sulphur fuel oil over the winter, amounting to about 1.2 million tonnes at current prices, but there were no fresh developments as to whether financing had been obtained.
Low sulphur cracked was steady around paper levels of $127-128 fob ARA although there was unconfirmed talk that $130 fob NWE had been done.
